title: Impacts of Fertilizer Subsidy on Smallholder Rice Productivity
question: Abstract: This study examines whether fertilizer subsidy improves rice yield and household income..
data: We use a panel dataset from 2018 to 2022 covering 1,240 farm households in three provinces..
sample: We use a panel dataset from 2018 to 2022 covering 1,240 farm households in three provinces..
methods: Methods: difference-in-differences with household fixed effects and robustness checks..
findings: Results show average yield increased by 8.6% and net income increased by 12.4%..
limitations: Limitation: the sample is concentrated in irrigated areas and may not generalize nationwide.
policy_implications: Policy implication: targeted subsidy design may improve welfare under budget constraints..
